content: Agentic QA products express soft verdicts as graded outcomes: Test Automate grades runs pass/fail/blocked; Errai ships confidence scores and separates real bugs from flaky failures; qa.tech reports via PR-comment plus dashboards. Common pattern: verdict + confidence + evidence (screenshots, video, logs) with human review queues for low-confidence or high-impact results. QASkills guidance: biggest risk of autonomous testing is false confidence; every successful deployment includes human oversight for validation, failure triage, coverage gaps.
